Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.

• Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

• Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

About you

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

• ETL and Database technologies.

• Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Company Description

Are you ready to take ownership of business-critical WMS solutions supporting JYSK's highly automated Distribution Centers across Europe?

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, employees are the key to success. Growing from one store in 1979 to more than 3,600 stores worldwide today, JYSK is a true retail success story – and Logistics play a crucial role in enabling our growth, both in stores and online.

The three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behavior and attitude you can expect from your new colleagues.

At JYSK, colleagues trust each other, and believe in delegation and freedom with responsibility. You are expected to speak up and have a say in your working environment.

Job Description

WHAT YOUR NEW JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As Product Owner for our WMS solutions, you are responsible for setting direction, driving priorities and ensuring that business-critical solutions continue to support JYSK's highly automated Distribution Centers across Europe. Working closely with Logistics, IT and external partners, you balance operational stability with continuous improvements that create real business value.

In this role, you ensure that our WMS platform continues to meet business needs while remaining stable and reliable in daily operations. You identify improvement opportunities, prioritize development efforts and help ensure that new functionality is implemented successfully and delivers value to our logistics setup.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Secure the stability and continuous development of our WMS solutions

• 
Own and prioritize the Team Backlog to maximize business value and impact

• 
Act as the connecting link between Distribution Centers, Logistics, IT and external partners

• 
Provide people leadership and development for a Business Solution Specialist in the Scrum team

• 
Enable high-quality delivery by making timely decisions and setting clear direction

• 
Drive refinement and alignment to ensure shared understanding across teams

Your primary base will be at our Distribution Center in Uldum. As the role is international, 20–40 travel days per year are expected.

Qualifications

WHAT YOU NEED TO BRING

We are looking for a person with experience from logistics IT solutions in highly automated warehouse environments, combined with a strong understanding of how business processes and IT systems work together.

In addition, you will be described by the below mentioned characteristics:

• 
Experience working with Warehouse Management Systems, either as Product Owner, Application Specialist, Consultant, Project Manager or similar

• 
Strong stakeholder management skills

• 
It will be considered an advantage if you have experience working with SSI Schaefer solutions such as WAMAS or ANT.

• 
Strong understanding of Warehouse Management Systems and logistics processes in automated warehouse environments

• 
Balance value, cost, risk and effort when making prioritization decisions

• 
Communicate in a structured and transparent way

• 
Great English skills

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

Recruitment process:

We process applications on an ongoing basis and complete recruitment when we find the right candidate.

If you have any questions, please contact IT Delivery Lead Pia Kristensen +45 40 90 50 71

ABOUT US

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page

If you’d like to know more about how we process your personal data and your rights, please check our Privacy Policy.

jobs.occupation: Physiological & Sports Medicine Advisor - Elite Football
jobs.description:
At Twinspire, we're building a digital twin platform for individualised athlete modelling in elite football. We are already testing this live in clubs through ongoing pilot studies.

The question we care about is simple: can data-driven signals actually support decisions that practitioners trust?

The role

We're looking for a physiotherapist, sports medicine professional, or physician with experience in elite or semi-elite football. Not to validate what we're building, but to challenge it.

This is not a narrow return-to-play role. We're looking for someone who can connect:

• physiology

• data

• research

• and real-world decision-making

You understand that athlete management is not clean or protocol-driven, but contextual, uncertain, and often subjective. That's exactly the gap we're trying to close.

What you will do

You will work directly with the founding team and DTU research group.

You will:

• Pressure-test whether model outputs make sense physiologically

• Call out when signals don't translate to real decisions

• Help bridge the gap between research and applied practice

• Shape what a useful signal actually looks like in elite environments

• Push us to build something that holds up under scrutiny, not just in theory

What we are looking for

Someone who:

• Has worked closely with elite or semi-elite football players

• Brings strong physiological and/or sports medicine expertise

• Is comfortable questioning both data and established practice

• Has felt the gap between what's measured and what's actually useful

• Wants to be part of defining what better looks like

What we offer

• Direct involvement in a validation study with elite football clubs across the Nordics

• Opportunity for research co-authorship

• Equity participation

• A chance to shape how athlete modelling is applied in real environments

Employment Type

Full-time

Location

Copenhagen, Denmark

Department

Science

If this resonates, reach out: roxane@twinspire.ai

DTU · Copenhagen · www.twinspire.ai

Are you passionate about regulatory processes and ensuring they work effectively across the product lifecycle?

Do you thrive in a structured, project-driven environment where your attention to detail and ability to create overview makes a real impact?

If you enjoy connecting the dots between processes, systems, documentation, and people, and occasionally asking "does this actually make sense?", you might fit right in.

We are looking for a Global Process Lead – Regulatory Affairs to join our Global Regulatory Affairs organization at our headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark.

You will become part of a collaborative and highly engaged team, working closely with stakeholders across functions and geographies. As Process Owner, you will help shape and develop regulatory processes across the product lifecycle and have real influence on how we work globally.

You will ensure that requirements, systems, documentation, and stakeholders work together in practice, not just on paper, while contributing to the implementation of a new Product Lifecycle Management system.

You will work across key Regulatory Affairs process areas, including labeling, product registration, and regulatory intelligence.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Act as Process Owner for the relevant regulatory process and ensure that it supports regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with related processes across the product lifecycle

• Ensure that the regulatory process remains effective, connected, and fit for purpose throughout the transition to a new lifecycle management system, while identifying opportunities for improvement

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of relevant QMS documentation and ensure consistency between process requirements and operational ways of working

• Identify dependencies, resolve gaps, and ensure alignment across functions and lifecycle stages

• Work closely with SMEs, Global Process Owners, and other stakeholders to align processes, responsibilities, interfaces, and supporting data requirements

• Participate in internal and external audits as Process Owner and explain how the process is governed, implemented, and maintained

• Support workshops, training, and change management activities to ensure consistent understanding and application of the process

**About You

**Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we know the perfect profile cannot be prescribed on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this role if you bring many of the following:

• A relevant academic degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or similar, along with experience working within Regulatory Affairs in a regulated industry such as medical devices or pharma

• You have a good understanding of regulatory processes and how they support products throughout the product lifecycle

• Experience with process ownership and process development in a regulated environment is a strong advantage

• Ability to shape and improve complex regulatory processes while ensuring alignment across functions and lifecycle stages

• A basic understanding of how systems support regulatory processes and data flows throughout the product lifecycle

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to create alignment across functions and organizational levels

• A structured and pragmatic approach, combined with strong analytical and communication skills

• You are fluent in English, both written and spoken

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**When to apply

**As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. If you are ready to apply for the position, please apply as soon as possible. We will invite candidates for interviews on a continuous basis so there is no need to hesitate.

If you have any questions about the position, you can contact Marianne Høy, Head of EndoIntelligence, Compliance and Processes at mahh@ambu.com.

**Private markets are being transformed — and you could be at the center of it.

**The gap between institutional grade private market tools and the technology that powers them has never been bigger. Trillions of dollars flow through private equity, venture capital, private credit, and real assets, yet the software managing this capital often lags a decade behind. SimCorp is changing that.

We're a fast-growing fintech company on a mission to modernize the private market ecosystem for institutional investors with cross-asset portfolios. We're scaling fast, our customers are the best in the world, and we're looking for a world-class Product Manager to help us build what comes next.

**If you understand the nuances of Private Markets, have a deep empathy for the professionals navigating this space, and know how to turn complexity into elegant software, we need to talk.

****WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a key component of product management for Private Markets, you will own the product strategy and execution alongside our engineering team. You will sit at the intersection of finance and technology translating the intricate workflows of private market professionals into intuitive, powerful software that delights users and drives business outcomes.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll work directly with the leadership, clients, market participants, engineering, sales and go-to-market teams, and you'll have real ownership over a product area that is central to our company's growth. You will shape the roadmap, define priorities, and rally a talented team of engineers and designers around a shared vision.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Orchestrate high-stakes product demonstrations, executive roundtables, and client conferences to evangelize the solution and secure stakeholder buy-in across diverse audiences.

• Define, own and evolve the product roadmap for our private markets platform, balancing short-term customer needs with long-term strategic vision.

• Be the primary point of contact, the go-to person for private markets and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strategically own, manage and prioritize the product backlog in lockstep with Leadership, balancing technical debt with high-value strategic investments to ensure seamless delivery.

• Deeply immerse yourself in the workflows of private markets - conducting interviews, shadowing users, and synthesizing feedback into actionable insights.

• Write crisp, well-reasoned product specifications and work hand-in-hand with engineering and design to ship high-quality features on time.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to author comprehensive user features and stories, establishing rigorous acceptance criteria to ensure all deliverables meet 'Definition of Ready' and 'Definition of Done' standards in the acceptance of deliverables.

• Define success metrics for every initiative and use data to evaluate outcomes, iterate quickly, and communicate results to stakeholders.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success to understand market gaps, competitive dynamics, and the evolving needs of our customer base.

• Identify and evaluate opportunities to integrate AI and automation into core workflows — making complex workflows faster, smarter, and more reliable.

• Drive alignment across cross-functional teams, ensuring clarity on priorities, tradeoffs, and the 'why' behind every decision.

• Stay ahead of regulatory developments, market trends, and competitive shifts in the private markets technology landscape.

• Represent the voice of the customer in every product decision — advocating relentlessly for user experience without sacrificing business viability.

**Who You Are

**You're not just a product manager, you're a private market expert who happens to love building software. You've spent time in or around private markets and you feel the pain points firsthand. You're the kind of person who gets genuinely excited when you see a workflow for the first time and immediately start mentally redesigning it. You are rigorous in your thinking, persuasive in your communication, and relentless in your follow-through.

You thrive in ambiguity. You can take a messy problem, break it down into its component parts, and build consensus around a path forward without needing every answer handed to you. You care about craft: a half-built feature or a confusing UX genuinely bothers you. And you're a collaborator at heart, you know that great products are built by great teams, and you know how to bring out the best in the people around you.

**What We Value

**

• 5+ years product management experience, with at least 2 years in B2B SaaS or fintech.

• Meaningful exposure to private markets, whether through prior work at a PE firm, fund administrator, placement agent, LP, or financial software company serving these markets.

• Demonstrated track record of successfully launching products and features that users love and that drive measurable business results.

• Strong understanding of private asset structures, capital calls, distributions, investor reporting, and related workflows.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you can write a tight one-pager and present to a room of skeptical executives with equal confidence and are not afraid to use AI.

• Proficiency in working with data: you're comfortable analyzing usage metrics and building dashboards to support your decisions.

• Experience collaborating with engineering teams in an agile environment; familiarity with modern development practices is a plus.

• High EQ and the ability to build trust quickly with customers, engineers, and senior leadership alike.

• A genuine curiosity about technology and its role in reshaping financial services.

• Experience engaging proactively with clients and stakeholders to solicit input for user stories.

• Broad knowledge of the Alternative Investment marketplace and system vendors.

• Experience with SimCorp Dimension® (advantageous but not required).

• Proven track record in roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, Engineering, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or Consultant within software development.

• Strategic mindset with strong analytical skills focused on business outcomes and complete product offers.

• Ability to encourage, motivate, and influence teams and peers; contribute to improvements across the community.

• Understanding of how great products are built and deliver value to clients.

• Creative and inquisitive mindset with the ability to simplify complex concepts.

• Degree in Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Finance, or a related field (preferred).

**Why Join Us

**

• Meaningful ownership — your decisions will shape a platform used by some of the world’s most sophisticated investors, and your work will have visible, lasting impact.

• A culture built on trust, autonomy, and deep collaboration.

• A leadership team with deep domain expertise, proven execution experience, and a genuine commitment to building an exceptional, humancentered culture.

• The opportunity to build category defining technology in a space undergoing massive transformation where your influence won’t just move the product forward, it will help reshape an entire industry.

• A place where craft matters, ideas win on merit, and people are encouraged to think boldly, act decisively, and do the best work of their careers.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Azeta GUITI Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experience, ages, and backgrounds in general.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated in our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients. While striving to deliver client value, we believe it is vital to consider our people and our planet in every business decision we make. Acting responsibly is not just optional, it is essential.

jobs.occupation: The Associate Director of QC Support , Laboratory Systems and Equipment
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Are you inspired by working in a company with ambitious goals? Our vision is that by 2030, Genmab’s knock-your-socks-off “KYSO” antibody medicines will be transforming the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases.

**The Role and Department

**Genmab's QC lab in Ballerup is growing in activities and we are now looking for an Associate Director of QC Support to join our team onsite in Ballerup.

The Associate Director of QC Support, Laboratory Systems and Equipment will be heading up the system team and equipment team, with the main purpose of supporting Genmab's QC operations within early- and late-phase as well as commercial products.

As a key member of the local QC leadership team, you will help shape and build a future-ready QC organization, ensuring scalable, innovative, and inspection-ready capabilities that enable accelerated development, successful product launches, and robust lifecycle management.

The role combines strategic leadership and transformation as a critical business enabler through digitalization, advanced analytics, and modern analytical technologies.

The laboratory is newly established, so expect a pioneering atmosphere, where you will help adjust the ways of working in an efficiency-oriented direction. We expect you to be ambitious, motivated, self-driven, and to be able to make your colleagues shine in an environment of respectful and flexible collaboration.

You will be joining a team of ambitious and professional colleagues within related fields, who can help you settle into your role, and keep the spirit high while performing the important tasks for our laboratory.

You will report to the Senior Director, Quality Control Lab.

**Responsibilities

**

• Build and lead the E-System Team providing business understanding, clear priorities and coordination of tasks

• Ensure a team environment that supports engagement, wellbeing and career development opportunities

• Develop, implement and maintain strategy and roadmap Laboratory Systems in Genmab's QC

• Ensure validation of relevant IT systems for the QC laboratory as System Owner

• Develop and manage the performance

• Serve as the primary point of contact across functional teams and external vendors

• Drive a culture of quality excellence, LEAN and continuous improvements

• Direct, guide, and monitor documentation and evolution of Standard Operating Procedures

• Support and participate in audits and regulatory agency inspections

• Ensure that QC employees comply with required safety and cGMP procedures and requirements

• Responsible for being compliant with Genmab's quality system

**Requirements

**

• It is expected that you hold a Master's degree in science or a related technical area

• Preferably 10+ years of relevant experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and/or medical device industry

• Strong experience working in a cGMP environment with knowledge of laboratory IT systems, QC equipment, testing, sampling and release.

• Experienced people leader

• Experience in working in cross-functional teams to accomplish shared goals

• Strong experience working in analytical and regulatory requirements

• Significant applied experience in laboratory operations, including development and adherence to quality metric programs

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK734.400,00---1.101.600,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

The Siteimprove Search Insights team builds the tools our customers use to understand and improve how their content performs in search, both in classic search engines and in the AI assistants that increasingly answer questions on their behalf. We work at enterprise scale, with large volumes of crawled and third party search data, visibility and ranking analysis, and features that turn that data into recommendations marketers can act on.

We are also changing how we build. AI is part of every step, from requirements, to breaking work down, to implementing and reviewing it with coding agents. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who wants to build this way, and who helps us define the standard while we do it.

Tech stack you will be working with

• 
C# and .NET, TypeScript, React

• 
AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes

• 
Event driven services and large scale data pipelines

• 
GitHub Actions for CI and CD

• 
Claude Code and other coding agents, MCP servers, Jira and Confluence as the working surface for the AI PDLC

What we will be doing

• 
Contribute to the technical direction of the team. Write the system designs for the work you own, take part in design reviews, and argue for the option you believe is right.

• 
Design and build systems yourself: services, APIs and data pipelines that stay stable, fast and affordable as data volumes grow.

• 
Lead our use of AI across the product development lifecycle. Take a product requirements document to a technical vision and system designs, break it into epics and user stories that an agent can act on, and set the standard at each step.

• 
Improve the scaffolding that makes agent driven delivery work: context and instruction files, prompts and skills, and the review and testing practice that keeps quality high when code arrives faster than before.

• 
Keep search data trustworthy, with tests, monitoring and errors a colleague can understand.

• 
Define how we measure quality, detect drift, and explain results to customers who make decisions based on them.

• 
Mentor engineers at all levels through design reviews, pairing and written technical proposals, including how to work well with agents.

• 
Treat cost, performance and operability as design inputs from the start.

• 
Take part in the daily work of the team: refinement, estimation, prototyping, debugging and production support.

• 
Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• 
Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• 
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science.

• 
10 or more years of professional software development experience.

• 
5 or more years building and running services and APIs on a public cloud, preferably AWS.

• 
A track record of architecture decisions that span several teams, including the trade offs you rejected and why.

• 
You have owned features or services end to end, including what happened after they were released.

• 
Hands on experience using coding agents in real production work, with a clear view of where they help and where they do not.

• 
Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms and data structures, and a commitment to technical excellence.

• 
Excellent written and verbal English. You write proposals and designs that other people, and agents, can act on without a meeting.

• 
Willingness to work across the stack when the problem calls for it.

What we will love about you

• 
Experience turning product requirements into technical designs and a delivery plan that a team can execute.

• 
Experience with search, SEO, crawling, indexing, ranking or web scale data.

• 
Experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

• 
Experience working in a team distributed across Europe and North America.

• 
You take pride in the work of the team and lead by example.

•

The Role

Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

We are introducing customer marketing as a dedicated discipline at Planday, and this is the role that will build it.

This is a builder's role: you will define how we market to our existing customers, establishing the strategy, the programmes, and the ways of working from the ground up. Across the UK, Nordics, and Germany, you will design and deliver 1:many marketing that drives adoption, deepens engagement, and turns customers into long-term advocates and expansion opportunities.

You will sit at the heart of our commercial ambition: as we target growth in the UK, defend our leadership in the Nordics, and build momentum in Germany, customer marketing is one of the key levers that connects product value to commercial outcomes. This is a role for someone who is energised by creating from scratch, earns trust through execution, and knows that the best customer marketing is grounded in deep empathy for the people you are marketing to.

What You'll Do

Establish the Discipline

• 
Define the customer marketing strategy - audit the current state of customer engagement across all three markets, identify gaps, and build a clear plan for how customer marketing will drive retention, adoption, and expansion at Planday

• 
Set the operating model - establish the ways of working, tools, segmentation logic, and measurement framework that will underpin everything the function delivers

• 
Act as the internal champion for customer marketing - educating and aligning stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales on the role and value of the discipline

Lifecycle & Engagement Programmes

• 
Build always-on 1:many customer engagement across the customer journey through marketing owned channels (e.g. email, in-product, socials, website)

• 
Develop localised programmes for UK, Nordics (Denmark, Norway, Sweden), and Germany - adapting content, tone, and sequencing to reflect the dynamics and customer expectations of each market

Adoption & Expansion

• 
Lead feature adoption campaigns - work closely with Product Marketing to identify the product features most strongly correlated with retention and satisfaction, and creating targeted campaigns that help customers get more from the platform

• 
Own upsell and expansion marketing - delivering behaviour-triggered campaigns that move customers up the tiers, support seat growth, and help customers discover the full value of Planday's offering

• 
Partner with Product Marketing on subscription plan communications and pricing changes, ensuring every customer-facing message reinforces product value and supports commercial goals

Advocacy & Community

• 
Build Planday's customer advocacy programme - identifying and activating champions within the customer base to generate case studies, reviews, testimonials, and referrals

• 
Support reference and social proof pipelines across markets - working with Sales, CS, Brand and Regional marketing to ensure high-quality customer stories are available for every stage of the buyer journey

• 
Explore community-building opportunities - partner with Regional Marketing to execute local community building opportunities such as webinars, customer events, and user groups, that deepen belonging and peer connection among Planday customers

Performance & Insight

• 
Define and own customer marketing metrics - including engagement rates, adoption scores, NRR contribution, upsell pipeline generated, and advocacy outputs and report regularly against them

• 
Use customer health data and behavioural signals to identify at-risk segments and inform targeted retention interventions

• 
Feed customer insight back into the wider marketing and product teams - ensuring the voice of the existing customer shapes how Planday communicates, evolves, and grows

What You'll Bring

Experience & Skills

• 
4–6 years in B2B marketing, with clear experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or retention-focused roles, ideally within a SaaS or technology business

• 
A track record of building programmes from scratch. You have experience establishing a new discipline, process, or team, not just inheriting and maintaining an existing one

• 
Multi-market experience, you are comfortable adapting strategy and execution for audiences across different regions, with an understanding of how culture and market maturity shape customer expectations

• 
Strong lifecycle marketing execution - you know how to design and deliver segmented, behaviour-triggered campaigns across email and in-product channels, and you understand the tools that power them

• 
Data-led - you use customer health scores, product usage data, and campaign performance metrics to make decisions, not just to report on them

• 
Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales, you understand the role each function plays in the customer journey and know how to align activity across them

• 
Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, SFMC, HubSpot) and an appetite to make better use of the data and tooling available

How You Show Up

• 
Customer-focused; you start with what the customer needs, not what the business wants to tell them

• 
A builder by nature; you are energised by the blank page, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating something that didn't exist before

• 
Commercially grounded; you understand how customer marketing connects to revenue and are comfortable being held to NRR and expansion metrics

• 
A natural collaborator; you build trust across functions without needing a mandate, and you bring people with you rather than working around them

• 
Clear and direct communicator; both written and verbal; you can simplify the complex, adapt your message to your audience, and get the room aligned

• 
AI-curious; you actively explore how AI can improve how you work, from personalisation and segmentation to content creation and performance analysis

Why Planday

• 
A genuinely greenfield opportunity, you will define what customer marketing looks like at Planday and build it your way

• 
Work at the intersection of commercial growth and customer experience, your work will have direct, measurable impact on retention and expansion

• 
A collaborative, ambitious marketing team that values craft, clarity, and getting things done

• 
Flexible location - London or Copenhagen, with a hybrid working model

• 
Competitive salary, benefits, and the opportunity to grow with the business as the function scales

Do you have experience leading system design and development of complex systems?

Weibel is recognized as a world leader in radar technology, with our radars performing with a precision largely unmatched by competitors. Applications for our radars include Space Research, Missile Defence, Instrumentation Systems and lately for Drone and UAS Detection and Defence. Our radars are developed and produced in-house which allows us to explore new solutions without compromising quality.

Increasing customer demand means that the company is experiencing rapid growth. As part of this growth, we are looking for a new colleague for our Systems Engineering team.

About the position

As our new colleague you will be responsible for system architecture including system documentation and associated requirements engineering. As the design authority on the system level, you will work in close cooperation with our subsystem architects, ensuring that the various subsystems work together in a manner that will satisfy the overall system requirements.

Working at Weibel will give you the opportunity to participate in the further development of our system engineering processes and tool chain. The position will also allow for influence on the direction of our future technology base.

The position will include the following tasks:

• Coordination of the overall technical solution with the Subsystem Architects and the Project Manager

• Technical point of contact to the customer

• Defining the overall architecture of the product, with focus on platform goals

• Comprehensive engineering effort and cost calculations together with technical experts

• Describing main subsystem requirements and interfaces between subsystems, with requirements flow down to the subsystem level

• Developing system budgets defining contributions from each subsystem

• Reviewing subsystem design and ensuring system level performance

• Working in close collaboration with integration and verification team, both in the requirements definition phase and at the verification stage

• Ensuring new solutions/designs are aligned with our technology roadmap and product direction as far as possible to enable maximum reuse in future deliveries

About you

You thrive in an environment that requires you to work independently on some tasks and in close collaboration with your colleagues on others. You prefer a fast work pace that allows you to work on many different tasks simultaneously where some require immediate action, and others focus on the long-term perspective.

You enjoy being a cross-functional coordinator with contact points in the entire organization. You are proactive and see possibilities rather than obstacles, and enjoy being a part of a continuous improvement chain.

You will work with many difference stakeholders, so it is key that you have good communication skills and the ability to present your results in an effective and structured manner.

Your CV should include:

• A university degree in electrical engineering, software engineering or similar

• Experience with customer contact

• Experience with systems engineering in relation to complex systems

• Knowledge of requirement engineering (Helix ALM)

• Practical experience with MBSE, preferably SysML, UML or similar (Enterprise Architect)

• Fluent in English both written and spoken.

• Experience with radar systems or complex systems for military use is considered an advantage.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the ”Apply” button. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Engineering Manager, Lina Klintberg, likl@weibel.dk

We will be holding interviews on an ongoing basis during the application period and may close the position before the application deadline. Therefore, please send us your application at your earliest convenience.
